_why: The ceiling for any single append-only event file, in MiB.
GitHub rejects a blob over 100 MiB and does it AT PUSH — after the ingest has
run and, on a hosted runner, after the ephemeral warehouse has been discarded.
So the whole run is lost to a limit discovered too late. `max_mib` sits below
the hard limit on purpose: a gate that fires at 100 fires exactly when the push
fails, which is no warning at all.
lines, every one of them kind:'new', because the delta is computed against a
warehouse that is gitignored and therefore always absent in CI.
It lives here rather than in the gate so the number is reviewable in a diff.
